_doc: Item cubes v3 layout rules (docs/design/ITEM_BOXES.md section 11). Read by tools/map/item_rows.py (author scripts, map tests) and tools/tests/item_cubes_spec.luau. Runtime numbers (shared 1.0 s respawn, rank lock, ghost cycle, pod heights, plane pickup lift) live in src/shared/ItemRules.luau CUBES. Stations are race stations along the lap (studs). A set is a front rank of 2 cubes and a back rank of 3, rankDepth studs further on (the owner's 'Staggered 2 + 3' mockup), so a racer can chain one cube of each rank on purpose: the second one levels the held item up (DKR).
_maxCubesPerMap: Above the 32 guide: 40 on SPACE-4 (8 sets of 5), 35 elsewhere. Each cube is 14 parts (ItemArt.CUBE_PARTS: glass, 12 edge bars, core; v2 was 22), so 40 cubes are 560 parts, under the v2 budget of 28 x 22 = 616. Only cubes within CUBES.animRange (340) animate: sets are at least 350 apart, so about 10, at most 15, tumble at once; the rest are anchored and still.
